local_tax_note: This estimate excludes local Earned Income Tax (EIT), which Pennsylvania municipalities and school districts levy separately — commonly 1%-3.9%+, with Philadelphia at the high end. Check your municipality's EIT rate at the PA Department of Community & Economic Development's local tax finder.
deviation_note: This is an estimate based on standard single-filer federal, FICA, and PA state calculations. Actual withholding may differ based on your W-4 elections, pre-tax deductions, local EIT, and other factors.
